defects.claim: Chunk substitution rewrites ordinary app string literals that match a placeholder marker, injecting icon data or failing the build on an unknown variant
defects.scenario: An app logs a string equal to the default marker: the build replaces it with serialized icon data. A string matching an unknown variant marker makes the build fail at catalog lookup.

defects.claim: Production watch builds do not add icon table JSON to the watch list, so catalog edits leave stale glyphs in the output
defects.scenario: Rollup watch build in production: the catalog JSON changes while no module in the bundle graph does, and the output keeps the old glyphs
